correctness.rationale: Stationarity gives equality in law of any forward digit block and a past block in the two-sided stationary extension (without time reversal of the process). Reversing index order in the weighted character proves the exact finite-prefix identity mu-hat(k/p^n)=E exp(-2pi i k U_n). The missing real-base-p tail lies in [0,p^-n], so |difference|<=2pi|k|p^-n for every prime, integer k, and n>=1. Lebesgue nu forces all finite past cylinders to have mass p^-m (endpoints are null), hence via stationarity independent uniform forward digits and Haar mu. Otherwise Fourier uniqueness yields nonzero nu-hat(k) and no Rajchman/positive Fourier decay. The deterministic all-(p-1) digit fixed point attains the sharp coefficient asymptotically at k=1. Independently enumerated prefixes of a non-reversible three-state stationary Markov chain for n<=6 confirmed the reindexing; finite enumeration is not the general proof.
